B
A standard Transformer block is composed of a multi-head self-attention mechanism followed by a position-wise feed-forward network (which is a type of MLP).

B
A multilayer perceptron (MLP) is characterized by having at least one hidden layer of neurons between its input and output layers. The use of non-linear activation functions within these neurons is crucial, as it allows the network to learn and approximate complex, non-linear functions.

B
The MLP, also known as the feed-forward network, takes the context-aware embeddings produced by the attention mechanism and applies a non-linear transformation to each one individually, allowing the model to process and learn more complex features.

C
The MLP's weights are adjusted during training to map specific input patterns (keys) to desired output patterns (values), effectively encoding facts as learned associations.

C
The weights (W) and biases (b) are the parameters that are adjusted during the training process. This tuning process is how the network learns from data, effectively encoding the "facts" or patterns into the values of W and b. These stored values are then used to make predictions (recall).
